partial.label: Partial (not predicted: the CDL labels have no partial class)

method.trained_on: CDL-labelled clusters in the 10 km box (preset field excluded), years [2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2023]
method.observations: Sentinel-2 only (field clear >= 0.5, >= 20 clear px); the model was trained on S2, so Landsat dates used by the rule calendar are not classified
method.daily_fill: linear interpolation of smoothed probabilities between observations <= 30 days apart, argmax; longer gaps unknown
method.markers: green_up = smoothed class becomes covered; senescence_harvest = covered -> bare
method.forward_years_note: years after the CDL labels end (no labels, never trained on); classified with the same frozen train-years model

sources.title: USGS NDVI, the foundation for remote sensing phenology
USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer via CroplandCROS (training labels)
